words.gloss: he who is in the heart

literal: As the lover is he who is in the heart, eating hot things we fear, knowing the burning.
translation: Since my lover resides in my heart, I fear eating hot food, knowing it would burn him.
modern: என் காதலர் என் நெஞ்சத்திற்குள் இருப்பதால், அவருக்குச் சுடும் என்பதை அறிந்து நான் சூடான உணவை உண்ணப் பயப்படுகிறேன்.
explanation: The heroine expresses the depth of her love by imagining her lover physically residing within her heart. Because he is always there, she avoids eating hot food. She fears that the heat of the food will burn him. This delicate hyperbole illustrates how constantly she holds him in her thoughts and how deeply she cares for his well-being.
